note: Franky's notebook. Written by the duck itself (the model's weights never change). tries = attempts the note was shown in, wins = how many of those succeeded.

knowledge.text: Beak grip requires banana middle within 7 cm and long side within 30 degrees across the beak.
Safety system refuses walks or turns that move the body too close to the table edge.
The pick_up tool is unknown; gripping must be attempted using close_beak.
Walk commands are imprecise; asking for 0.25 m forward resulted in 0.24 m forward, and 0 degrees turn resulted in 8 degrees left.
The vision model can return no match for an object even if it is present on the table.
open_beak successfully releases items held in the beak.
The safety system refuses walks that would take the body too close to the table edge (e.g., Step 13, Step 17).
Calling close_beak() when the banana is already held results in no change (Step 16).

skills.text: To pick up the banana, align it across the beak and ensure its middle is close enough (within 7 cm).
When moving, account for slight deviations in distance and direction from the requested command.
If find fails, attempt the search again, as the object may be present but undetected.
When moving, plan movements cautiously to avoid triggering the safety refusal near the edge (S3).
